Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with signs or symptoms or risk of cardiovascular disease may participate in this training protocol.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a history of multiple myocardial infarctions, stenting, bypass surgery, and ischemic cardiomyopathy, all of which are clear indicators of cardiovascular disease.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Pregnancy, for those patients who require testing or treatment requiring dobutamine, gadolinium or contrast media or radiation exposure.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is male, so pregnancy is not applicable.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Inability of patient, parent or legal guardian to provide informed consent.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has provided written informed consent.

Recap: The patient meets the inclusion criteria due to his significant cardiovascular disease history and does not violate any exclusion criteria.
